Right (centred): a "Live Preview" caption and a card previewing it: image https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1511795409834-ef04bbd61622?w=400&h=200&fit=crop (mediumFeature), the event name, a row "Celebrating" (body) + guest, the date as "EEEE, MMMM d, yyyy 'at' h:mm a" (body), and "Location: " + the first selected location (caption).

args.format: EEEE, MMMM d, yyyy 'at' h:mm a

reference_express:
surface("gallery-invitation-builder", sendDataModel=true)
$/event/date = "2025-07-15T19:00:00Z"
$/event/guest = "Alex Johnson"
$/event/location = ["ballroom"]
$/event/name = "Summer Gala"
root = Column([header, main_content], _, "stretch")
header = Text("# Invitation Builder")
main_content = Row([editor_col, preview_col], _, "start")
editor_col = Column([editor_title, event_name_input, guest_input, date_input, location_picker], _, "stretch", 1)
editor_title = Text("### Customize your invitation")
event_name_input = TextField("Event Name", $/event/name)
guest_input = TextField("Guest of Honor", $/event/guest)
date_input = DateTimeInput($/event/date, true, true, _, _, "Event Date & Time")
location_picker = ChoicePicker("Location", "mutuallyExclusive", [{label: "Grand Ballroom", value: "ballroom"}, {label: "Sunset Terrace", value: "terrace"}, {label: "Garden Pavillion", value: "garden"}], $/event/location, "chips")
preview_col = Column([preview_title, invitation_card], _, "center", 1)
preview_title = Text("Live Preview", "caption")
invitation_card = Card(invitation_content)
invitation_content = Column([invite_image, invite_event_name, invite_guest_row, invite_date_text, invite_location_text], _, "center")
invite_image = Image("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1511795409834-ef04bbd61622?w=400&h=200&fit=crop", _, _, "mediumFeature")
invite_event_name = Text($/event/name)
invite_guest_row = Row([invite_for_text, invite_guest_name], _, "center")
invite_for_text = Text("Celebrating", "body")
invite_guest_name = Text($/event/guest)
invite_date_text = Text(formatDate($/event/date, "EEEE, MMMM d, yyyy 'at' h:mm a"), "body")
invite_location_text = Text(formatString("Location: ${/event/location/0}"), "caption")

intent: Validated sign-up form bound to /formData (email, phone, zip, agree): greeting with today's date (2026-08-19T17:45:00Z), email with an email check, phone matching ^\+?[0-9]{10,15}$, Zip Code matching ^[0-9]{5}$ ("Must be exactly 5 digits"), checkbox "I have read the club rules", and "Create account" (sign_up, context data: /formData) guarded by agree AND (email OR phone required) AND zip required, with the message "You must agree to terms AND provide either Email or Phone, plus a Zip code."

reference_express:
surface("gallery-advanced-validator", sendDataModel=true)
$/formData/agree = false
$/formData/email = ""
$/formData/phone = ""
$/formData/zip = ""
$/now = "2026-08-19T17:45:00Z"
root = Card(main_column)
main_column = Column([welcome_text, email_field, phone_field, zip_field, terms_checkbox, submit_btn], _, "stretch")
welcome_text = Text(formatString("Hello! Today is ${formatDate(value: ${/now}, format: 'EEEE, MMMM d')}."))
email_field = TextField("Email Address", $/formData/email, ?email("Invalid email format"))
phone_field = TextField("Phone Number", $/formData/phone, ?regex(r"^\+?[0-9]{10,15}$", "Invalid phone format"))
zip_field = TextField("Zip Code", $/formData/zip, ?regex("^[0-9]{5}$", "Must be exactly 5 digits"))
terms_checkbox = CheckBox("I have read the club rules", $/formData/agree)
submit_btn_text = Text("Create account")
submit_btn = Button(submit_btn_text, _, Event("sign_up", {data: $/formData}), ?and([$/formData/agree, or([required($/formData/email), required($/formData/phone)]), required($/formData/zip)], "You must agree to terms AND provide either Email or Phone, plus a Zip code."))
